recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a mobile-first portrait browser story-choice game titled **Throne of Petty Crowns**. Preserve a five-question, three-choice, three-affinity scoring loop with fail threshold and tiered faction endings. Reframe the loop as a satirical medieval succession council where the player is the royal Hand advising rival houses. Use procedural canvas art for a throne room: central Iron Ledger, three house sigils, dragon embers, frost creeping from the north, and raven/knife intrigue motifs. Controls are large touch-friendly choice cards. HUD terms are Embercourt, Frostwatch, and Thornledger influence. Endings should reveal which house wins the succession or whether the realm collapses into bureaucratic exile.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source truth
The preserved game is a browser-native story choice game. The player starts from an overlay, answers five dialogue turns, each turn offers three tappable choices, and each choice adds a signed score to one of three affinity tracks. After the fifth turn the game calculates the highest affinity; if the best score is below 3 the fail ending appears, otherwise one of three tiered endings for the winning track appears. Restart resets turn and scores.

## Protected mechanics
- Start button reveals play HUD and loads turn 1.
- Exactly five sequential choice prompts.
- Three choices per prompt, each mapped to one affinity and score delta.
- HUD shows all three affinity scores, including negative values.
- End state is determined by highest score with failure threshold below 3 and three score tiers per winning faction.
- Restart returns to turn 1 with zero scores.

## Reinterpreted target
The same mechanics become a satirical royal council succession hearing. The three affinity tracks are warring houses: Embercourt dragon loyalists, Frostwatch apocalypse sentries, and Thornledger scheming spymasters. Choices are political counsel, scores are influence, and endings decide who controls the Iron Ledger.
